hook: Your credit card gives you rewards, an app and fraud protection. So who pays for all of it? Card companies charged Americans more than $100 billion in interest in a single year. In this video I follow the money from three angles: the 8 ways cards make money, the 5 design tricks that keep you paying, and 10 rules so your card makes almost nothing from you.
